links.outcome: Agreement of GPT-4 hypertension medication recommendations with cardiologist recommendations on same patient data
links.effect: 95% of 40 patients had conflicting overall recommendations; only 10.2% of specific medication recommendations matched; Cohen's kappa -0.0127 (no agreement).
links.quote: Out of the 40 patients, 95% had conflicting overall recommendations between the physician and GPT-4, with only 10.2% of the specific medication recommendations matching between the two.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparison of GPT-4 medication recommendations against cardiologist recommendations using real patient charts without testing an operational guardrail or deployment practice.
